blocks.content: Course: Make Your Code Work on Every Screen
Have you ever opened a website on your phone and had to zoom in just to read the text, or scroll sideways because nothing fit?

blocks.alt: Same website, two very different experiences

blocks.content: Frustrating, right? And honestly, pretty common.
Most of the time it happens for one simple reason. The site was only ever built for one screen size.
By the way, I'm Anuj, the same developer who built the HTML and CSS course and the Figma to Code course.
In this course you'll learn how to make your website respond correctly to different screen sizes.
▶️ Click Next Lesson to see what we're going to build.
